lines: Maheshkumar Gopalbhai Patel is a Promoter Selling Shareholder, receiving proceeds from selling 4,98,000 shares in the offer for sale.
Proceeds of up to ₹4.93 to ₹5.23 crore arrive on or before Friday, November 06, 2026, per the timetable, not yet confirmed by a listing notice.
Gain of ₹4.73 to ₹5.03 crore before offer expenses and taxes; retained shares are locked in for 12, 24 and 36 months from allotment.
Retained holding is unknown because the pre-offer holding is not confirmed from the documents.
